lines.cyr: Садило моме, моме, мори моме,
lines.lat: Sadilo mome, mome, mori mome,
lines.en: A girl planted, girl, hey girl,

lines.cyr: ран бел босилок, моме, мори моме,
lines.lat: ran bel bosilok, mome, mori mome,
lines.en: early white basil, girl, hey girl,

lines.cyr: ран бел босилек.
lines.lat: ran bel bosilek.
lines.en: early white basil.

lines.cyr: Ка го садило, моме, мори моме,
lines.lat: Ka go sadilo, mome, mori mome,
lines.en: When she planted it, girl, hey girl,

lines.cyr: не го видело, моме, мори моме,
lines.lat: ne go videlo, mome, mori mome,
lines.en: she didn't look into it, girl, hey girl,

lines.cyr: не го видело.
lines.lat: ne go videlo.
lines.en: she didn't look into it.

lines.cyr: Кога го виде, моме, мори моме,
lines.lat: Koga go vide, mome, mori mome,
lines.en: When she saw it, girl, hey girl,

lines.cyr: орман се стори, моме, мори моме,
lines.lat: orman se stori, mome, mori mome,
lines.en: it grew into a forest, girl, hey girl,

lines.cyr: коњ да пладнува.
lines.lat: konj da pladnuva.
lines.en: enough for a horse to rest in it.

lines.cyr: Коњ да пладнува, моме, мори моме,
lines.lat: Konj da pladnuva, mome, mori mome,
lines.en: A horse to rest, girl, hey girl,

lines.cyr: и лудо младо, мори моме,
lines.lat: i ludo mlado, mori mome,
lines.en: and a crazy lad, hey girl,

lines.cyr: ем неженено.
lines.lat: em neženeno.
lines.en: who is also not married.

lines.cyr: Тропнало оро големо, големо,
lines.lat: Tropnalo oro golemo, golemo,
lines.en: A big dance started, big,

lines.cyr: пред поповата вратица, вратица.
lines.lat: pred popovata vratica, vratica.
lines.en: in front of priest's entrance.

lines.cyr: Сите девојки дојдое, дојдое,
lines.lat: Site devojki dojdoe, dojdoe,
lines.en: All the girls came, they came,

lines.cyr: Стојна Попова не дојде, не дојде.
lines.lat: Stojna Popova ne dojde, ne dojde.
lines.en: only Stojna Popova didn't come.

lines.cyr: Стојна Попова не беше, не беше,
lines.lat: Stojna Popova ne beše, ne beše,
lines.en: Stojna Popova wasn't there, wasn't there,

lines.cyr: мајка ѝ бисер нижеше, нижеше.
lines.lat: majka ì biser nižeše, nižeše.
lines.en: her mother was making a pearl necklace.

lines.cyr: Мајка ѝ бисер нижеше, нижеше,
lines.lat: Majka ì biser nižeše, nižeše,
lines.en: Her mother was making a pearl necklace,

lines.cyr: и си ја Стојна учеше, караше:
lines.lat: i si ja Stojna učeše, karaše:
lines.en: and taught Stojna, she scolded her:

lines.cyr: - Стојно ле мила, ќерко ле, ќерко ле,
lines.lat: - Stojno le mila, ḱerko le, ḱerko le,
lines.en: - Stojna dear, my daughter, my daughter,

lines.cyr: кога ќе одиш на оро, на оро,
lines.lat: koga ḱe odiš na oro, na oro,
lines.en: when you go to see the oro, the oro,

lines.cyr: на танец да не се фаќаш, не фаќаш,
lines.lat: na tanec da ne se faḱaš, ne faḱaš,
lines.en: don't go and start to dance, to dance,

lines.cyr: на танец ти е лудото, младото.
lines.lat: na tanec ti e ludoto, mladoto.
lines.en: because the crazy lad will be dancing.

lines.cyr: Со нога ќе те поткачи, поткачи,
lines.lat: So noga ḱe te potkači, potkači,
lines.en: He will stumble you with his leg, trip you up,

lines.cyr: со рака ќе те поттурне, поттурне.
lines.lat: so raka ḱe te potturne, potturne.
lines.en: he will push you with his arm, push you.
